Q: Briley Christopher Oxley asked whether both issue 120 and the Django REST Framework issue would be closed — A: Juhe Lee confirmed that both are tied to the pull request and will be closed once it is merged.
Q: Briley Christopher Oxley asked if fixing the reported PsychoPG bug was a low-hanging fruit — A: Juhe Lee confirmed it was an easy task that only requires updating the version number.
